name: Ruan
source:
"It is me who can provide you with the very best. You can be my bride."

A devil whose existence is power, no one reigns over him. His power, followed by ruin, shines even more with the bride.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=kr.co.studiolumiere.devilspropose]English Google Play[/url]]
